description: This Swift file implements a WKURLSchemeHandler for handling custom URL schemes in a web view, serving local files securely from a specified root directory. It provides functionality to respond to URL requests, serve index pages, handle errors, and prevent directory traversal attacks. The class is specifically tailored for integrating a web-based canvas rendering system within a macOS application.

classes.name: CanvasSchemeHandler
classes.description: A class conforming to WKURLSchemeHandler that manages HTTP-like requests for custom schemes, serving local HTML and other resources securely within a specified root directory.

methods.name: init(root: URL)
methods.description: Initializes the handler with the root directory for serving files.

methods.name: webView(_: WKWebView, start urlSchemeTask: WKURLSchemeTask)
methods.description: Handles the start of a URL scheme task, serving the appropriate response data or error.

methods.name: webView(_: WKWebView, stop _: WKURLSchemeTask)
methods.description: Handles the stopping of a URL scheme task (no-op implementation).

methods.name: response(for url: URL) -> CanvasResponse
methods.description: Generates a response (html, file data, or error message) for a given URL, serving local files or fallback pages.

methods.name: resolveFileURL(sessionRoot: URL, requestPath: String) -> URL?
methods.description: Resolves the requested file URL within the session root, handling directory index logic.

methods.name: resolveIndex(in dir: URL) -> URL?
methods.description: Finds index.html or index.htm in the specified directory.

methods.name: isFileURL(_: URL, withinDirectory: URL) -> Bool
methods.description: Checks if a file URL is within a given directory boundary for security.

methods.name: html(_: String, title: String) -> CanvasResponse
methods.description: Creates a simple HTML page response with provided body and title.

methods.name: welcomePage(sessionRoot: URL) -> CanvasResponse
methods.description: Generates a welcome page indicating that Canvas is ready and suggesting creating index.html.

methods.name: scaffoldPage(sessionRoot: URL) -> CanvasResponse
methods.description: Provides a default scaffold page if no index.html is present, or fallback to a welcome page.

methods.name: loadBundledResourceData(relativePath: String) -> Data?
methods.description: Loads a resource bundled within the app, given a relative path.

methods.name: textEncodingName(forMimeType: String) -> String?
methods.description: Determines the appropriate text encoding name based on MIME type.
